title: Small Cancellation Stability and Isomorphism Rigidity for Generic Finitely Presented Groups
summary: Let $F_m=F(a_1,\dots,a_m)$ with $m\ge 2$, and fix $q\ge 1$. For every fixed $0<λ<1$, we prove that a $q$-tuple $\mathbf W_n$ of independent uniformly random cyclically reduced words of length $n$ is \emph{$λ$-stable} with probability converging to $1$ exponentially fast. Namely, for every $Φ\in Aut(F_m)$, the tuple $Φ(\mathbf W_n)$, after cyclic reduction and symmetrization, satisfies the $C'(λ)$ small cancellation condition.
